localChanges: With the browser set to block site data, the game showed a blank page. It now opens its main menu, as it does for someone who has imported nothing, and if the game can't start for any other reason it says so, with a Reload button (closes #850).
The classic Game menu works from the keyboard: Enter or Space opens it and chooses from it, the arrow keys, Home and End move through it, and Escape closes it (closes #853).
The classic Trade report shows a city's name exactly as it is written, whatever characters it holds (closes #849).
In Adjust Trade Rates, a screen reader now says which rate each slider and number box is for (closes #857).
A game saved before the research picker said why it opened now has it say so too (closes #870).

log: A save keeps each object's key list, and hydration restores it as it was, so a game saved before 0.1.8 never sent `cleared`, however often it was saved again. `onHydrated` adds whichever of the research's keys the save lacks, as CityBuild does for its own (civ-clone/web-renderer#870).
CI now runs the standard workflow: pnpm on current Node, prettier with --check, and a failure on stale compiled output. package-lock.json is removed (civ-clone/web-renderer#66).
